images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished abstract editorial cover image for a thoughtful independent engineering blog. Article: 'Everyone wants Durable Agents', about computation continuing after failure, persistent state and reconnecting pieces. Visual: a sculptural continuous cobalt-blue ribbon forms an elegant open loop across three separated translucent glass planes; one small interruption in a plane, yet the ribbon continues intact, suggesting continuity across replaceable infrastructure. Artistic abstraction, not a technical diagram. Premium tactile 3D editorial still-life, frosted glass, porcelain and deep cobalt material, subtle fine grain, sophisticated soft natural side-light and believable shadows. Restrained palette drawn from the website: cobalt blue #2563eb, graphite, near-white #fafaf8. Broad landscape canvas approximately 1.91:1, ideally 1536x804 or 1536x800. Strong legible central silhouette, generous whitespace at every edge, full-bleed pale background, composition holds up in a small social link preview and safe centered cropping. No text, lettering, symbols, logos, watermarks, robots, brains, circuit boards, glowing sci-fi effects or stock-tech imagery. Produce a single image, not a grid or variations.
